name: verify_owner
description: Verify that the caller is the registered owner of a unit. Call only after the caller has said both the unit number and the last four digits of the registered mobile; never with empty or guessed values. Required before sharing or changing anything about a specific unit.

unit_number.description: Unit number as the caller says it, normalised to the form COMMUNITY-BUILDING-UNIT, e.g. CRK-A-1204 (Lumora Creek, Tower A, apartment 1204) or OAS-TH-031 (Lumora Oasis, townhouse 31). Use uppercase letters.

phone_last4.description: The last four digits of the mobile number registered to the unit, digits only.

name: get_handover_status
description: Get the handover readiness of a verified unit: ready, not ready (with the outstanding items) or already handed over.

unit_number.description: The verified unit number, e.g. CRK-A-1204.

name: get_handover_slots
description: List available handover appointment slots for a verified unit that is ready for handover.

preferred_date.description: Optional preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD format if the caller gave one. Leave empty otherwise.

name: book_handover_appointment
description: Book a handover appointment slot. Only call after the caller has explicitly confirmed the slot.

slot_id.description: The slot_id returned by get_handover_slots for the slot the caller chose.

name: get_service_charges
description: Get the service-charge account for a verified unit: annual rate, area, current balance, due date, status and last payment.

name: create_maintenance_ticket
description: Create a maintenance ticket for a unit. Only call after reading the summary back and the caller confirming it.

category.description: The best-matching category for the issue.

urgency.description: emergency: active flooding, fire, smoke, gas, sparking, lift entrapment. urgent: no AC in summer, no water, a leak that is contained, a front door that will not lock. routine: everything else.

location_in_unit.description: Where in the unit, e.g. master bathroom, kitchen, balcony.

description.description: A one or two sentence description of the problem in English, whatever language the caller used.

name: request_human_callback
description: Create a case for the Lumora care team to call the owner back, with a summary so they do not have to repeat themselves. Use for complaints, refunds or cancellations, legal or contractual disputes, payment plans, sales enquiries, failed verification, emergency follow-up, or whenever the caller asks for a person.

reason.description: Why the callback is needed. complaint: unhappy with a service, a delay or a charge, including requests for compensation. refund_or_cancellation: wants money back for a payment or to cancel a purchase. legal_or_dispute: contractual or legal dispute, or mentions lawyers or courts. payment_plan: wants to pay service charges in instalments. sales_enquiry: wants to buy, rent or resell. verification_failed: could not be verified. emergency_followup: after an emergency. caller_request: asked for a person with no other reason. other: anything else.

priority.description: high for emergencies and distressed callers, otherwise normal.

summary.description: Two sentences in English: what the caller needs and what has already been done in this call.

caller_language.description: The language the care team should call back in.

contact_number.description: Only for callers who could not be verified: the number they want to be called on. Leave empty for verified owners (the number on file is used).
